title: IBM SevOne Network Performance Management 7.0.0 through 8.2.2 could allow a local attacker to execute… (CVE-2026-95867)
description: IBM SevOne Network Performance Management versions 7.0.0 through 8.2.2 contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow a local attacker with high privileges to execute arbitrary code. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.7, indicating medium severity. No patch or remediation information is provided in the available data.
